decisions.reason: It is a core sports-flooring system close to the firm's woodworking and installation know-how, so despite some uncertainty after a 2019 launch it is still worth retaining.
A mobile arena floor is a niche, project-driven product and the overlap with another mobile arena system makes portfolio rationalisation likely.
This second mobile arena floor appears to duplicate a very specialized offer, so management would likely cut it to focus resources on stronger core lines.
Chevron hardwood parquet fits the firm's wood-flooring capabilities and can stay in the range as a differentiated premium design product.
Squash court surface finish is a narrow niche with limited market scale, making it a plausible candidate for withdrawal in favor of broader sports-floor products.
Oak skirting is a simple complementary accessory for sports floors and is cheap to maintain in the catalogue, so it is likely to be kept.
